YHB1: The Lord bestows bliss upon His devotees, and gives them a seat in the eternal home.
God bestows bliss on His faithful adorers and seats them in the eternal home.
JVMB: He does not give the sinners any stability or place of rest; He consigns them to the depths of hell.
To the sinners He allows not stability. Picking them up, He consigns them to the terrible hell.
Y2C6: The Lord blesses His devotees with His Love; He sides with them and saves them. ||19||
The Lord blesses His devotees, with His love and taking their side saves them.
SKD4: False-mindedness is the drummer-woman; cruelty is the butcheress; slander of others in one's heart is the cleaning-woman, and deceitful anger is the outcast-woman.
Evil-intellect is the she-drummer, heartlessness is the butcheress, other's slander in the heart is a sweepress and deceitful wrath is a pariah-women.
UK14: What good are the ceremonial lines drawn around your kitchen, when these four are seated there with you?
What does the drawing of lines avail you when these four are seated with you?
1LNK: Make Truth your self-discipline, and make good deeds the lines you draw; make chanting the Name your cleansing bath.
Make righteousness your abstinence, pious way of life yours lines and the Name's meditation your abolition.
DMAH: O Nanak, those who do not walk in the ways of sin, shall be exalted in the world hereafter. ||1||
Nanak, they alone shall be exquisite here-after who do not walk the way of sins.
E0JW: Which is the swan, and which is the crane? It is only by His Glance of Grace.
What is a swan and what is a crane? The Lord may show mercy to any He likes
95W2: Whatever task one wishes to carry through, one should pray to the Prabhu (for its fulfilment).
Whatever work you wish to accomplish-tell it to the Lord.
Whatever works, you desirest to do, tell that to the Lord.
Whatever work we want done, let us speak of it to Hari; the meaning is, let us pray before Vahiguru.
85AW: Satgur sakhiai = through the Guru's teaching.
(In this way,) through the Satguru's teaching, the ever-abiding Prabhu sets the task right.
He will resolve your affairs; the True Guru gives His Guarantee of Truth.
He shall accomplish your affair. The True Guru bears true testimony to it.
O brother! Vahiguru will set right every task; this is the Satguru's true testimony — that is, true teaching.
JZJD: Whoever is pleasing to Him, O Nanak, is transformed from a crow into a swan. ||2||
He, who is pleasing to Him, O Nanak! him He makes a swan from a crow.
1XJN: Sang = in the company. Nidhan = treasure.
In the company of the saints the treasure of the Name is found, and the water of the Name, which gives spiritual life, can be tasted.
In the Society of the Saints, you shall taste the treasure of the Ambrosial Nectar.
By the company of the Saints, you shall taste the treasure of the Name-Nectar.
In the company of the saints is the treasure of the amrit of the Name, and through them it is tasted; the meaning is, the Name is repeated.
BLLM: (So one should make this prayer:) O Hari, destroyer of fear and giver of mercy! Keep the honour of Your servant.
The Lord is the Merciful Destroyer of fear; He preserves and protects His slaves.
The merciful Lord, the destroyer of dread, preserves the honour of His slave.
Let one pray like this: O Vahiguru, merciful destroyer of fear! Keep the honour of me, Your servant.
MMAT: Gun gai = singing the praises. Lakhiai = one comes to understand. Sach = the ever-abiding Prabhu. ||2||
O Nanak! (In this way,) by praising the Prabhu, one forms a bond with the unseen Prabhu. ||20||
O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and see the Unseen Lord God. ||20||
Nanak, sing you the praises of God and you shall see the invisible Lord.
Sri Guru ji says: so, singing the virtues of Hari, the Prabhu who is unseen is (lakhiai) seen — that is, known. ||20||
ECSG: Body and soul, all belong to Him. He gives His Support to all.
Our soul and body are all His. He lends supports to all.
XXF8: O Nanak, become Gurmukh and serve Him, who is forever and ever the Giver.
By Guru's instruction, serve Him who is ever and ever the donor.
AXWK: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Formless Lord.
I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the formless Lord.
2SVQ: Their faces are forever radiant, and the whole world bows in reverence to them. ||1||
Their faces are ever bright, and the whole world makes obeisance to them.
DHQW: Meeting the True Guru, I am totally transformed; I have obtained the nine treasures to use and consume.
On meeting the True Guru, I am altogether altered, and I have obtained the nine treasures to spend and eat.
0KFD: The Siddhis-the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers-follow in my footsteps; I dwell in my own home, within my own self.
The eighteen miracles follow me in train and I abide in my own home and own place.
1NSC: The Unstruck Melody constantly vibrates within; my mind is exalted and uplifted-I am lovingly absorbed in the Lord.
Unbeaten celestial strain ever plays for me and in the state of exaltation I am absorbed in God's affection.
XYFZ: O Nanak, devotion to the Lord abides within the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||
Nanak, God's devotion abides within the heart of those on whose forehead such fate is found inscribed from the very out set.
D9U6: I am a minstrel of the Lord God, my Lord and Master; I have come to the Lord's Door.
I am a minstrel of Lord God, the Master and have come to His gate.
0WAQ: The Lord has heard my sad cries from within; He has called me, His minstrel, into His Presence.
God listened to my loud plaint from within and me, the bard, He called into His presence.
NGMW: The Lord called His minstrel in, and asked, "Why have you come here?"
Calling the eulogist in, God asked him the object of his arrival there.
R5N7: "O Merciful God, please grant me the gift of continual meditation on the Lord's Name."
O my merciful Master God! ever grants me the gift of Your Name meditation.
6ZFY: And so the Lord, the Great Giver, inspired Nanak to chant the Lord's Name, and blessed him with robes of honor. ||21||1||Sudh||
God, the Bestower, caused Nanak to remember Lord's Name and clothed him with the robe of honour.
MJQV: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the True Guru's favour He is obtained.
N18K: Siree Raag, Kabeer Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Ayk Su-Aan" :
Sri Rag, by Reverend Kabir. To be sung to the tune of "Ayk Su-Aan".
K6T6: The mother thinks that her son is growing up; she does not understand that, day by day, his life is diminishing.
The mother thinks that her son is growing up; but this much she understands not, that day by day his age is diminishing.
8V1T: Calling him, "Mine, mine", she fondles him lovingly, while the Messenger of Death looks on and laughs. ||1||
Calling him mine, my own, she fondles him excessively. The king of death's couriers looks and laughs.

DNXB: You have misled the world so deeply in doubt.
So much have You, O Lord! misled the world in illusion.
XQYX: How can people understand You, when they are entranced by Maya? ||1||Pause||
How can it understand You, O Master! since mammon has bewitched it? Pause.
GQL1: Says Kabeer, give up the pleasures of corruption, or else you will surely die of them.
Says Kabir, abandon the pleasures of sin, for you shall assuredly die in their association.
FK0Q: Meditate on the Lord, O mortal being, through the Word of His Bani; you shall be blessed with eternal life. In this way, shall you cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
O mortal! remember you the omnipresent Lord, by means of Gurbani, the grantor of eternal life. In this way, you shall swim across the terrible ocean.
E1KA: As it pleases Him, people embrace love for the Lord,
When it pleases Him, it is then that man comes to embrace love for the Lord,
QU89: and doubt and delusion are dispelled from within.
and the error of superstition departs from within him.
9U8X: Intuitive peace and poise well up within, and the intellect is awakened to spiritual wisdom.
Equipoise is produced and the intellect awakens towards Divine knowledge.
3U4G: By Guru's Grace, the inner being is touched by the Lord's Love. ||3||
By Guru's grace, the heart is touched by Divine love.
PVZ9: In this association, there is no death.
In this association of God, there is no death.
FDHL: Recognizing the Hukam of His Command, you shall meet with your Lord and Master. ||1||Second Pause||
Recognise His order and than shall you meet the spouse. Second. Pause.
Y21P: The mind is totally attached to Maya; the mortal has forgotten his fear of old age and death.
In the mortal's mind is the great love of wealth through which he has forgotten the fear of old age and death.
J3ZS: Gazing upon his family, he blossoms forth like the lotus flower; the deceitful person watches and covets the homes of others. ||1||
On beholding your family you bloomest like the lotus flower. O vicious man! you espies other's homes.
2787: When the powerful Messenger of Death comes,
When the powerful courier of death comes,
NUMY: No one can stand against his awesome power.
I cannot stand before before his awesome power.
R82S: Rare, very rare, is that friend who comes and says,
Rare is the friend, who having come into this world says,
ESHJ: "O my Beloved, take me into Your Embrace!
Meet my Beloved and embrace me with Yours arms around me.
FZ01: O my Lord, please save me!" ||1||Pause||
Meet me my pervading God and rescue me. Pause.
5QV4: Indulging in all sorts of princely pleasures, O mortal, you have forgotten God; you have fallen into the world-ocean, and you think that you have become immortal.
O mortal, in various and diverse pleasures and royal revelments you have forgotten God and falling into this world ocean you deemest that you have become imperishable.
YX9V: Cheated and plundered by Maya, you do not think of God, and you waste your life in laziness. ||2||
Cheated by mammon you thinkest not of the Lord and you, the idle man, wastest away your life.
GQ3M: The path you must walk is treacherous and terrifying, O mortal; neither the sun nor the moon shine there.
O mortal! you have to tread a difficult and terrible path, where the sun and moon have no entrance.
USN9: Your emotional attachment to Maya will be forgotten, when you have to leave this world. ||3||
When man leaves the world he forgets the love of mammon, then.
SU5F: Today, it became clear to my mind that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is watching us.
Today it has become manifest my mind that the Righteous Judge continues spying mortals.
J8R2: His messengers, with their awesome power, crush people between their hands; I cannot stand against them. ||4||
There, his supremely powerful couriers crush men between their hands, and I can not stand up against them.
PLN9: If someone is going to teach me something, let it be that the Lord is pervading the forests and fields.
If someone gives me instruction, then, it ought to be this that Pervading God is contained in woods and grass blades.
9FS9: O Dear Lord, You Yourself know everything; so prays Trilochan, Lord. ||5||2||
Says Tirlochan O my venerable Pervading God! You Yourself knowest everything.
FCNK: Listen, O religious scholar: the One Lord alone is Wondrous; no one can describe Him.
Listen, O Pandit! the one Lord alone is worderous. I cannot now describe Him
69M4: He fascinates the angels, the celestial singers and the heavenly musicians; he has strung the three worlds upon His Thread. ||1||
Who have bewitched demigods men, celestial heralds and musicians, and has nailed the three worlds.
ZK69: The Unstruck Melody of the Sovereign Lord's Harp vibrates;
The sovereign Lord's lyre plays unstruck,
H97M: by His Glance of Grace, we are lovingly attuned to the Sound-current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||
and through His kind glance one comes to cherish affection for the music. Pause.
92LQ: The Tenth Gate of my crown chakra is the distilling fire, and the channels of the Ida and Pingala are the funnels, to pour in and empty out the golden vat.
I have obtained the tenth gate as a still, with a funnel to suck in and a funnel to spit out, and mind as a golden vat.
X4KU: Into that vat, there trickles a gentle stream of the most sublime and pure essence of all distilled essences. ||2||
In that vat, the extremely pure steam of Name Nectar trickles. Like this I have distilled the essence of essences.
QL2Y: Something wonderful has happened-the breath has become the cup.
An incomparable thing has happened, My breathe, I have made the wine-cup.
JQUW: In all the three worlds, such a Yogi is unique. What king can compare to him? ||3||
In the three worlds he is the unique Yogi (who drinks such wine). Say, which king can equal him?
HCB0: This spiritual wisdom of God, the Supreme Soul, has illuminated my being. Says Kabeer, I am attuned to His Love.
Says kabir, such knowledge of the Supreme Person has manifested itself, that I have been imbued with His love.
ETBX: All the rest of the world is deluded by doubt, while my mind is intoxicated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||3||
The rest of the world is all deluded by doubt but my soul is intoxicated with the elixir of pervading God.3

Y8CW: Sree Raag, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Pehray":
Sri Rag, Saint Beni. To be sung in the tune of Pahre.
C8NQ: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the favour of the True Guru He is obtained.
P2R1: O man, when you were coiled in the cradle of the womb, upside-down, you were absorbed in meditation.
O man! when you wert in the belly's coil, you didst meditate and fix your attention on the Lord, standing on your head.
LFAZ: You took no pride in your perishable body; night and day were all the same to you-you lived unknowing, in the silence of the void.
You harboured not the pride of the dignity of your perishable body and being completely rid of ignorance you contemplated over one God, day and night.
455X: Remember the terrible pain and suffering of those days, now that you have spread out the net of your consciousness far and wide.
Recall the travail and supreme suffering of those days Now you have greatly extended the net of your mind
QYHP: Leaving the womb, you entered this mortal world; you have forgotten the Lord from your mind. ||1||
Leaving the womb you entered this mortal world. Then, you, O man! didst forget God in your mind.
VYBD: Later, you will regret and repent-you fool! Why are you engrossed in evil-mindedness and skepticism?
You shall, afterwards, repent, O fool! through what evil intellect are you attached to scepticism?
Q7Z3: Think of the Lord, or else you shall be led to the City of Death. Why are you wandering around, out of control? ||1||Pause||
Remember the pervading Lord, otherwise you shall go to the city of death's myrmidons. Why, O man! do you wander unrestrained? Pause.
GR1C: You play like a child, craving sweets; moment by moment, you become more entangled in emotional attachment.
A child feels anxiety for plays and sweet and by degrees it gets entangled in worldly love.
1RQS: Tasting good and bad, you eat nectar and then poison, and then the five passions appear and torture you.
In the misunderstanding of savoury and scared ambrosia, man eats poison and then, the five passion appear and then torture him.
Y04G: Abandoning meditation, penance and self-restraint, and the wisdom of good actions, you do not worship and adore the Lord's Name.
Man abandons meditation, toilsome service, self-restraint and propensity towards good actions and repeats not pervading Lord's Name.
4YZ9: You are overflowing with sexual desire, and your intellect is stained with darkness; you are held in the grip of Shakti's power. ||2||
His lust overflows, blackness attaches to his understanding and then he hugs to his bosom another's woman.
J4DL: In the heat of youthful passion, you look with desire upon the faces of other men's wives; you do not distinguish between good and evil.
In the arduour of youth, he stars at the faces of other wives and distinguishes not between good and evil.
1B53: Drunk with sexual desire and other great sins, you go astray, and do not distinguish between vice and virtue.
In the intoxication of lust and other great sins he goes amiss and distinguishes not vice from virtue.
82D7: Gazing upon your children and your property, your mind is proud and arrogant; you cast out the Lord from your heart.
By beholding his sons and wealth, this mind of his goes proud and he forgets the pervading Lord from his heart.
NXN1: When others die, you measure your own wealth in your mind; you waste your life in the pleasures of the mouth and sexual organs. ||3||
On another's death he weighs his wealth in his heart. You, O Man! has wasted your life in the pleasure of urinary orifice (ravishment) and mouth (dainties).
Z6SX: Your hair is whiter than the jasmine flower, and your voice has grown feeble, as if it comes from the seventh underworld.
His grey hair are whither than even the jasmine flower and his voice grows feeble as if it proceeds from the seventh under-world.
QGW7: Your eyes water, and your intellect and strength have left you; but still, your sexual desire churns and drives you on.
When his eyes water and his intellect and strength flee, then the desires begin to churn him.
3FLG: And so, your intellect has dried up through corruption, and the lotus flower of your body has wilted and withered.
Therefore with vices his soul is gone dry and the lotus flower of his body has withered away.
MD12: You have forsaken the Bani, the Word of the Immortal Lord, in this mortal world; in the end, you shall regret and repent. ||4||
By renouncing the word of the Immortal Lord in this mortal world, You, O man! shall regret afterwards.
X1NM: Gazing upon the tiny bodies of your children, love has welled up within your heart; you are proud of them, but you do not understand.
Beholding the small bodies (children) love springs in man's mind and he takes pride on them but understands not the Lord.
Z3CT: You long for the dignity of a long life, but your eyes can no longer see anything.
Though his eyes see not anything still he cherishes longing for the dignity of long life.
8FHY: Your light has gone out, and the bird of your mind has flown away; you are no longer welcome in your own home and courtyard.
The fire is extinguished, the soul bird has flown away and his corpse is not now tolerated in home and courtyard.
47YJ: Says Baynee, listen, O devotee: who has ever attained liberation after such a death? ||5||
Says Beni, hear O saint! who has obtained salvation after (such an ignoble) death?
Y2F1: You are me, and I am You-what is the difference between us?
You are me, I am You, What is the difference.
6M96: We are like gold and the bracelet, or water and the waves. ||1||
The same as between gold and its bracelet and between water and its ripples.
D886: If I did not commit any sins, O Infinite Lord,
If I did not commit sins, O my Infinite Lord!
EQKY: how would You have acquired the name, 'Redeemer of sinners'? ||1||Pause||
How should you have gained the Name of the Redeemer of sinners? Pause.
RCD3: You are my Master, the Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts.
You, who are my Master art the searcher of hearts.
J4V6: The servant is known by his God, and the Lord and Master is known by His servant. ||2||
From the Lord is knows His servant and from the servant his Lord.
91V2: Grant me the wisdom to worship and adore You with my body.
Grant, me the Wisdom to meditate on You with my body.
C9U0: O Ravi Daas, one who understands that the Lord is equally in all, is very rare. ||3||
Some rare person can explain to me that the Lord is uniformly contained among multitudes (all) O Ravdas!

2EAB: Raag Maajh, Chau-Padhay, First House, Fourth Mehl:
Y5CM: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
There is but One God. True is His Name, creative His personality and Immortal His form. He is without fear without enmity, unborn and self-illumined. By the favour of the True Guru he is obtained.
S692: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.
Lord God's Name is in every way pleasing to my mind.
HA6V: By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.
By the great good fortune, I have pondered over God's Name.
3AWZ: The Perfect Guru has attained spiritual perfection in the Name of the Lord. How rare are those who follow the Guru's Teachings. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has obtained perfection in God's Name. A few walk in the Guru's way.
3SQS: I have loaded my pack with the provisions of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
The viaticum of God's Name, I have tied to my skirt.
LC3V: The Companion of my breath of life shall always be with me.
The succourer of my soul shall ever, bear my company.
UTM1: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me. I have the Imperishable Treasure of the Lord in my lap. ||2||
The Perfect Guru has implanted God's Name (in my heart). In my lap I have imperishable wealth of God's Name.
HD2V: The Lord, Har, Har, is my Best Friend; He is my Beloved Lord King.
The Lord God is my friend. He is my beloved Monarch.
11XT: If only someone would come and introduce me to Him, the Rejuvenator of my breath of life.
Let some one come and introduce me to God, the Rejuvenator of my very life.
3K7J: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved. My eyes are welling up with tears. ||3||
I cannot live without seeing my Darling. The tears are profusely falling down my eyes.
XRU1: My Friend, the True Guru, has been my Best Friend since I was very young.
My friendly True Guru is my infantine intimate.
W441: I cannot survive without seeing Him, O my mother!
I cannot sustain life without a sight of him, O my mother!
RPA9: O Dear Lord, please show Mercy to me, that I may meet the Guru. Servant Nanak gathers the Wealth of the Lord's Name in his lap. ||4||1||
O venerable God! show mercy and cause me to meet the Guru. From his slave Nanak shall gather the wealth of God's Name, in his lap.
7MCK: The Lord is my mind, body and breath of life.
Lord, the Lover of Nectar, is my soul, body and very life.
29VX: I do not know any other than the Lord.
Without God, I recognise no other second.
HX5C: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly Saint; he might show me the Way to my Beloved Lord God. ||1||
If by greatest good fortune some friendly saint meets me, he would show me the way to Lord God, my Beloved.
WF3N: I have searched my mind and body, through and through.
I search and seek my heart and body.
859J: How can I meet my Darling Beloved, O my mother?
How shall I meet my amiable Beloved, O my mother?
7DHD: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I ask about the Path to God. In that Congregation, the Lord God abides. ||2||
Joining the society of saints, I inquire about the track to God. In the saints congregation, the Lord God abides.
XK5N: My Darling Beloved True Guru is my Protector.
My sweet, darling, the True Guru, is my protector.
RB7D: I am a helpless child-please cherish me.
I am a helpless child, cherish me, O my Guru.
HSYX: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water of the Guru, the lotus of my heart blossoms forth. ||3||
The great and perfect True Guru, is my mother and father. By obtaining the Guru-water my heart-lotus blooms.
4ANM: Without seeing my Guru, sleep does not come.
Without seeing the Guru, I find no sleep.
LA2S: My mind and body are afflicted with the pain of separation from the Guru.
The separation from the Guru afflicts my soul and body with pain.
0PEF: O Lord, Har, Har, show mercy to me, that I may meet my Guru. Meeting the Guru, servant Nanak blossoms forth. ||4||2||
O Lord God! show mercy to me and cause me to meet the Guru. By meeting the Guru, slave Nanak blossoms forth.5

GCBH: Read of the Lord's Glories and reflect upon the Lord's Glories.
Recite God's glories and God's glories do you reflect upon.
RMHY: Listen continually to the Sermon of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
Ever hearken you, O man! the discourse of Lord Master's Name.
WCDR: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall cross over the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||1||
By meeting the society of saints and singing God's praises, the arduous and hideous world-ocean is ferried over.
J4VK: Come, friends, let us meet our Lord.
Come my maids! let us meet our Lord.
NVFS: Bring me a message from my Beloved.
They shall give me the message of my love.
W7NZ: He alone is a friend, companion, beloved and brother of mine, who shows me the way to the Lord, the Lord of all. ||2||
He alone is a friend, comrade, beloved and brother of mine, who shows me the way to the Lion-man, the incarnation of God.
N9ZP: My illness is known only to the Lord and the Perfect Guru.
My malady the perfect Divine Guru Knows.
FUMX: I cannot continue living without chanting the Naam.
I cannot live without uttering Lord's Name.
VQPR: So give me the medicine, the Mantra of the Perfect Guru. Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am saved. ||3||
Give me the medicine of God's Name, O my Perfect Guru! it is through Lord God's Name that I swim across.
YZTW: I am just a poor song-bird, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru,
I am a poor pied-cuckoo, in the sanctuary of the True Guru.
0JGX: who has placed the Drop of Water, the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in my mouth.
The Guru has oozed the drop of the Name of Lord God in my mouth.
9JD2: The Lord is the Treasure of Water; I am just a fish in that water. Without this Water, servant Nanak would die. ||4||3||
God is the treasure of water, and I a fish in that water. Without this water, servant Nanak, meets his end.
84V8: O servants of the Lord, O Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny, let us join together!
O saints, O servants of God! meet me, my brothers.
2XPA: Show me the way to my Lord God-I am so hungry for Him!
Tell me of my Lord God, I feel hunger for Him.
L8LK: Please reward my faith, O Life of the World, O Great Giver. Obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. ||1||
My Bestower, the Life of the world, fulfil my faith. By obtaining the sight of God my soul is sated.
CZGZ: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I chant the Bani of the Lord's Word.
Joining the saints society, I recite Divine Guru's hymns.
SNG2: The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.
Lord Master's discourse is pleasing to my mind.
DYE2: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is so sweet to my mind. Meeting the True Guru, I drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||
The ambrosia of God's Name, is in every way, sweet to my Soul, I quaff the Name Nectar-by meeting the True Guru.
362E: By great good fortune, the Lord's Congregation is found,
By great good luck, man finds God's congregation.
1507: while the unfortunate ones wander around in doubt, enduring painful beatings.
The unfortunate ones wander in doubt and sustain strokes.
BL8H: Without good fortune, the Sat Sangat is not found; without this Sangat, people are stained with filth and pollution. ||3||
Without good fortune the guild of the righteous is not found. Without such an association one is soiled with the filth of sins.
65UW: Come and meet me, O Life of the World, my Beloved.
Come and meet me, O my Beloved, the life of the world.
N1CH: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and enshrine Your Name, Har, Har, within my mind.
Be merciful, O Lord God! and implant Your Name in my heart.
YEMJ: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Sweet Name has become pleasing to my mind. Servant Nanak's mind is drenched and delighted with the Naam. ||4||4||
Under Guru's instruction, the sweet Name has become pleasing to my mind, and slave Nanak's soul is over joyed with the Name.
23Q7: Through the Guru, I have obtained the Lord's spiritual wisdom. I have obtained the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
From the Guru, I have obtained God's knowledge and Lord God's elixir.
TXBU: My mind is imbued with the Love of the Lord; I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
My soul I imbued with God's love and drinks God's Nectar.
